About these measurements

Triangles and draw calls cover the whole scene, including the ground and shadow receivers. The texture estimate covers unique uncompressed tree textures and mipmaps. Browser FPS measures sustained drawing and may be capped by the device refresh rate. Each grove instances four seeded variations of the current recipe. The sun shadow map refreshes when you change the scene.

Growth and bark references

Branches grow from their parent shoot’s local axis and taper based on the shoots they support. Leaf placement follows each twig, with species-specific spacing and tilt. The model draws on Weber and Penn’s branching model, Okabe’s work on phyllotaxis, and measured oak and birch leaf inclinations. Bark uses repeating color and normal maps from Poly Haven oak, cgbookcase birch, and Poly Haven pine.
